name: Gathering nodes reported after the GatherMate2 import are gone after its revert (#10542, #10619, #10632, #11205, #11293)
contract: rev_20261105_100_coa_revert_gathermate_nodes (#11290) deletes the GatherMate2 import nodes (guids 12000000-12099999) outside Pale Reach and restores the stock pools. At each reported spot the import node the report described does not spawn: Searing Gorge Blackchar Cave ore in terrain 12007669 (#10542), the Eastern Plaguelands Gold Vein 12010182 near the report (#10619), the Stagnant Oasis Briarthorn inside a tree 12017140 (#10632), the out-of-reach Deathknell Copper Vein 12010065 (#11205) and the floating Duskwood nodes 12010708/12010705 (#11293). The restored stock ore spot 205463 at the cave entrance and the stock Briarthorn 213377 at the oasis stand on the ground.
